about.title: About Me
about.description:
Hey, I'm Navid 👋 a self-taught frontend engineer. I started with React in 2021, found my home in Vue, and have spent four years building Vue and Nuxt products, most recently full-time in a remote Scrum team at Dongi.

Learning without a roadmap made me careful and curious: I test what I ship and pick up new tools early. You can see it in Vue Smart Loading Kit, my open-source Vue library checked with mutation testing, and in a daily AI workflow with Claude Code, Codex and Copilot, kept in check by tests and types.

My main stack is Vue 3, Nuxt, TypeScript, Pinia and Tailwind CSS, and I also build with React and Next.js; this site itself is built with Next.js. I care about the parts users feel but rarely see: accessibility, Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, and RTL and multilingual interfaces.

I hold a bachelor's degree in psychology, which still shapes how I think about the people using what I build. I speak Persian (native), English (advanced) and Turkish (basic).

I'm looking for a team where I can own a frontend and keep growing.
